rule.name: Remove spaces before certain punctuation, typically . , : ; ? !
rule.description: No space is placed before certain punctuation marks

rule.name: Convert two periods (..) in parenthesis by ellipsis (…)
rule.description: Two consecutive dots in parentheses or brackets most likely indicate an error and should be replaced with an ellipsis

rule.name: Two hyphens to en-dash
rule.description: Two hyphens to en-dash

example.before: word -- word number--number
example.after: word – word number–number

rule.name: Convert figure dash to dash between letters
rule.description: Converts figure dash U+2012 into standard dash

example.before: Sapir‒Whorf hypothesis
example.after: Sapir–Whorf hypothesis

rule.name: Remove zero-width characters (U+200B–200D)
rule.description: Remove zero-width spaces, zero-width non-joiner and zero-width joiner to make GREP-based search and replace operations more effective

example.before: www.type​together.com
example.after: www.typetogether.com

rule.name: Em-dash to en-dash
rule.description: Em-dash to en-dash

rule.name: Three or four periods to ellipsis (U+2026)
rule.description: Three or four periods to ellipsis

rule.name: Delete space between quotation marks (hairspace could be added consistently in the next step if required)
rule.description: If primary and secondary quotation marks appear consecutively in the text, no spaces are inserted between them (unless this is a deliberate typographical choice)

rule.name: Replace two single quotes ’ ’ with one double quotation mark ” (correct form of quotation marks to by modified in next step)
rule.description: Replace two single quotation marks ’’ (U+2019) to double high-9 quotation mark ” (U+201D)

example.before: word’’ (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)
example.after: word” (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)

rule.name: Replace two single quotes ‘ ‘ with one double quotation mark “ (correct form of quotation marks to be modified in next step)
rule.description: Replace two single quotation marks ‘‘ (U+2018) to double high-6 quotation mark “ (U+201C)

example.before: ‘‘word (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)
example.after: “word (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)

rule.name: Replace two single quotes ‹ ‹ with one double quotation mark « (correct form of quotation marks to be modified in next step)
rule.description: Replace two single left-pointing angle quotation ‹‹ (U+2039) to left-pointing double angle quotation « (U+00AB)

example.before: ‹‹word word‹‹ (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)
example.after: «word word« (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)

rule.name: Replace two single quotes › › with one double quotation mark » (correct form of quotation marks to be modified in next step)
rule.description: Replace two single right-pointing angle quotation ›› (U+203A) to left-pointing double angle quotation » (U+00BB)

example.before: ››word word›› (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)
example.after: »word word» (The change may not be visible, change font style to Typofix EU Special to see the difference)

rule.name: Replace multiple tabs by single tab
rule.description: Multiple tabs are likely a mistake in the text, although they may be part of a legacy table format. In most cases, it is safe to replace them with a single tab (or eventually replace them with a space, or remove them entirely)

category.name: Spaces
Run first – remove extra or double spaces, convert all spaces to standard space (prefs)

example.before: Multiple Tabs ↦↦Multiple Tabs Multiple Tabs↦↦
example.after: Multiple↦Tabs ↦Multiple Tabs Multiple Tabs

rule.name: Remove all kinds of spaces (horizontal and vertical) at the end of the story
rule.description: Removing all vertical and horizontal spaces at the end of a thread.

category.name: Spaces
Run first – remove extra or double spaces, convert all spaces to standard space (prefs)

example.before: This is the end of story. This is the end of story.
example.after: This is the end of story. This is the end of story.

rule.name: Remove spaces adjacent to a tab
rule.description: Spaces next to tabs serve no purpose in the text and should be deleted

category.name: Spaces
Run first – remove extra or double spaces, convert all spaces to standard space (prefs)

example.before: text ↦ text text↦ text text ↦text text ↦
example.after: text↦text text↦text text↦text text↦

rule.name: Ratio / map scale without spaces around colon
rule.description: Remove spaces around colon in ratios (1:100)

rule.name: Delete an extra space at the end of a paragraph
rule.description: A space at the end of a paragraph or article is unnecessary and should be deleted

example.before: Hello! Hello! Hello!↦
example.after: Hello! Hello! Hello!

rule.name: Delete an extra space at the beginning of a paragraph
rule.description: There should be no space at the beginning of a paragraph; any paragraph indentation can be adjusted by setting the paragraph parameters in the application

example.before: Hello! Hi. Ahoj
example.after: Hello! Hi. Ahoj

rule.name: No spaces in three-part abbreviations with periods
rule.description: Remove spaces in abbreviations like ΠΑ.Δ.Α. or t.o.m.

example.after: (The last period may be removed in Estonian depending on Preferences)

example.before: t. o. m. (Swedish)
example.after: t.o.m. (Swedish)

rule.name: Remove spaces before ellipsis at the end of a sentence
rule.description: Remove space before ellipsis at the end of a sentence

example.before: Jag vet inte riktigt … Men vi kan försöka. (Swedish)
example.after: Jag vet inte riktigt… Men vi kan försöka. (Swedish)

rule.name: No spaces in two-part abbreviations with periods
rule.description: Removes spaces from abbreviations like κ.λπ.

example.before: t. ex. t. ex.
example.after: t.ex. t.ex.

rule.name: No spaces in two-part abbreviations with one period
rule.description: In certain abbreviations, no space is added after the period

example.before: fil. mag Anderson fil. dr Janis Walander tekn. dr Matthias
example.after: fil.mag Anderson fil.dr Janis Walander tekn.dr Matthias

rule.name: Add space after punctuation if missing at the end of a sentence (Finnish and Swedish)
rule.description: A space is required after punctuation (. ! ? ‽ …) at the end of a sentence

example.before: Me, or her.Oh my god 5.7 (no change) File.pdf (no change) address@gmail.com (no change) ftp.domain.eu/test (no change)
example.after: Me, or her. Oh my god 5.7 (no change) File.pdf (no change) address@gmail.com (no change) ftp.domain.eu/test (no change)

rule.name: Connect initials using nonbreaking space (J. F. or J. R. R.)
rule.description: A space is typically written between initials; in some languages, you can choose the width of this space in the preferences.

example.before: J. F. Kennedy J. R. R. Tolkien
example.after: J. F. Kennedy J. R. R. Tolkien

rule.name: Nonbreaking space after military ranks
rule.description: Typically "Col Muller"

rule.name: Nonbreaking spaces in two-part abbreviations
rule.description: In established abbreviations consisting of two parts – such as names of institutions or media outlets – a non-breaking space is used to prevent them from being split at the end of a line

example.before: France 24 Al Jazeera Teil 6 (German) TV 2 (Danish) ČT 1 (Czech) AV ČR (Czech) III Rzesza (Polish) ÚS SR (Slovak) TVR 2 (Romanian) HRT 2 (Croatian)

rule.name: Keep Pantone numbers with suffixes
rule.description: Pantone number code should not be separated from suffix C or U

example.before: Pantone 123 C Pantone® 123 U
example.after: Pantone 123 C Pantone® 123 U

rule.name: Keep number and large number abbreviations together using nonbreaking space
rule.description: Keep number and large number abbreviations together using nonbreaking space (7 mil.)

example.before: 20 tn (Swedish)
example.after: 20 tn (Swedish)

rule.name: Connect town name with a district number (Praha 1)

rule.name: Connect town name with a district Roman number (Liberec IV)
rule.description: In some countries, city districts are numbered using Roman numerals, these elements should be joined with a non-breaking space so they do not split at the end of a line

example.before: Pardubice VII (Czech, Slovak) Pardubice I-Staré Město (Czech, Slovak) Pardubice I – Staré Město (Czech Academic)
example.after: Pardubice VII (Czech, Slovak) Pardubice I-Staré Město (Czech Traditional, Slovak) Pardubice I – Staré Město (Czech Academic)

rule.name: Nonbreaking space between single-word abbreviations and numbers (Nr. 20)
rule.description: There should be a non-breaking space between the abbreviation and the number to prevent the expression from being split at the end of the line

example.before: IQ 151 (many languages) ID 48006584 (all languages) tel. 244 (many languages)
example.after: IQ 151 (many languages) ID 48006584 (all languages) tel. 244 (many languages)

rule.description: There should be a non-breaking space between the abbreviation and the following word so that the abbreviation does not end up at the end of the line

rule.name: Keep number and large number words together using nonbreaking space (30 millions)
rule.description: A numeric value should be connected to a numeral with a non-breaking space to prevent the expression from being split at the end of a line

example.before: 30 miljarder (Swedish)
example.after: 30 miljarder (Swedish)

rule.name: Non-breaking Space in Biblical Book Abbreviations (Tim, 2 Tim etc.)
rule.description: The numbered abbreviations of the books of the Bible should include a non-breaking space to prevent the term from being split at the end

rule.name: Non-breaking space in Bible verse reference
rule.description: Bible book, chapter and verse should be connected by non-breaking space so as to avoid splitting the expression at the end of the line

example.before: 1 Co 15,26 (French, Spanish) 1 Cor 15,26 (English, Italian, Romanian) 1 Kor. 15:26 (Dutch)
example.after: 1 Co 15,26 (French, Spanish) 1 Cor 15,26 (English, Italian, Romanian) 1 Kor. 15:26 (Dutch)

rule.name: Connect a specific word with following letter
rule.description: Connect certain words with following letter using nonbreaking space (Exhibit A, Generation Z etc.)

example.before: bokstaven A (Swedish) Generation Z (English) Vitamine C (Dutch)
example.after: bokstaven A (Swedish) Generation Z (English) Vitamine C (Dutch)

rule.name: Connect numbers up to four digits before closing parenthesis with the last word (final value 11)
rule.description: A number in parentheses should not start the next line, so it is joined to the preceding word with a non-breaking space

example.before: (total value 11) [last number 2001]
example.after: (total value 11) [last number 2001]

rule.name: Nonbreaking space after abbreviations marking birth or death before the date
rule.description: Abbreviations to mark birth or death before the date are separated by a nonbreaking space

rule.name: Add space before ellipsis in the middle of a sentence
rule.description: A space is placed before an ellipsis in a sentence; please note that it may also be an incomplete word, in which case no space is used

example.before: Han tog fram sin… och började skriva. (Swedish) The policy settings were… comprehensive. (English) Han tog sin... frem og begyndte at skrive. (Danish)
example.after: Han tog fram sin … och började skriva. (Swedish) The policy settings were … comprehensive. (English) Han tog sin ... frem og begyndte at skrive. (Danish)

rule.name: Add missing spaces after closing parenthesis or brackets
rule.description: Add missing spaces after closing parenthesis or brackets

example.before: (word)word
example.after: (word) word

rule.name: Replace space by nonbreaking space between ordinal number with suffix and following word
rule.description: Replace space by nonbreaking space between ordinal number with suffix and following word (1st price)

example.before: Vi slutade på 2:a plats i tävlingen.
example.after: Vi slutade på 2:a plats i tävlingen.

rule.name: Replace space by nonbreaking space between ordinal number marked with period and following word
rule.description: Replace space by nonbreaking space between ordinal number marked with period and following word (1. místo)

example.before: Vi slutade på 2. plats i tävlingen.
example.after: Vi slutade på 2. plats i tävlingen.

rule.name: Connect capitalised names with Roman numerals (useful for popes, emperors – Charles IV etc.)
rule.description: The name is joined to the Roman numeral with a non-breaking space to prevent the expression from being split at the end of a line

example.before: Charles IV Johannes Paul II Karl IV Kehä III
example.after: Charles IV Johannes Paul II Karl IV Kehä III

rule.name: Replace space by nonbreaking space between long Roman ordinal number and following word
rule.description: Keep long Roman ordinal number and following word (XXII wiek)

rule.name: Nonbreaking space between abbreviations and Roman numbers (Nr. XVI)
rule.description: There should be a non-breaking space between the abbreviation and the number to prevent the expression from being split at the end of the line

rule.name: Remove duplicate redundant punctuation before closing parenthesis
rule.description: Commas and semicolons are not repeated and are only placed after parentheses

example.before: Type punctuation (comma,), then save the file. (any language)
example.after: Type punctuation (comma), then save the file. (any language)

rule.name: Add period after certain abbreviations if missing
rule.description: Add period after certain abbreviations if missing (et al > et al.)

example.before: John Newton et al
example.after: John Newton et al.

rule.name: Remove Spanish inverted punctuation in languages other than Spanish
rule.description: Inverted punctuation (¡ ¿ ⸘) is only used at the start of a sentence in Spanish; therefore, it must be removed in other languages.

example.before: ¿Къде са тоалетните? ¡Λοιπόν, αυτό! ⸘Wie ist das möglich‽ ¿¡⸘
example.after: Къде са тоалетните? Λοιπόν, αυτό! Wie ist das möglich‽ [should be empty]

rule.name: Comma in Bible verse reference 1 Kor 3,18 or Mt 12,43–44
rule.description: For Bible references, the chapter and verse numbers are separated by a comma

example.before: Versen 1 Kor 15:26 talar om den sista fienden. 1 Kor 15:26
example.after: Versen 1 Kor 15,26 talar om den sista fienden. 1 Kor 15,26

rule.name: Replaces two periods by a single period
rule.description: A second period is not repeated at the end of a sentence or phrase. (However, it is possible that the author intended an ellipsis …)

example.before: three dots… (not affected) two dots.. two (..) dots two.. dots τρείς τελείες… (not affected) δύο τελείες.. δύο (..) τελείες δύο.. τελείες
example.after: three dots… (not affected) two dots. two (.) dots two. dots τρείς τελείες… (not affected) δύο τελείες. δύο (.) τελείες δύο. τελείες

rule.name: Wrong apostrophe to the correct form at the end of a word
rule.description: A proper apostrophe has the specific shape of a small number 9 or a line that tapers downward and slopes to the right

example.before: test ’s (no change) test ‘s’ (quotation marks may change to a version defined in preferences
example.after: test ’s (no change) test ‘s’ (quotation marks may change to a version defined in preferences)

rule.name: Wrong apostrophe to the correct form ’ (U+2019) inside expressions
rule.description: A proper apostrophe has the specific shape of a small number 9 or a line that tapers downward and slopes to the right

example.after: Kelly’s d’Artagnan L’Humanité He’ll Pierre’em Curie They’ve 80’erne test ’s (no change) test ‘s’ (quotation marks may change to a version defined in preferences

rule.name: Upside down apostrophe to correct form ’ in French expressions
rule.description: The correct form of the apostrophe resembles either a small 9 or a comma that narrows towards the bottom

example.before: d‘Artagnan L‘Humanité
example.after: d’Artagnan L’Humanité

rule.description: Change Modifier Letter Double Apostrophe (U+02EE ˮ) and “ U+201C used as a double quotation mark, to Right Double Quotation Mark (U+201D ”)

rule.name: Secondary quotation marks ’x’
rule.description: Replace the secondary quotation marks in the text with the ’x’ style

example.before: ”Det där är en 'mästare' inom sitt hantverk!”
example.after: ”Det där är en ’mästare’ inom sitt hantverk!”

rule.name: Primary quotation marks ” ”
rule.description: Replace the primary quotation marks in the text with the ” ” style

example.before: "Jag ska åka på en konferens" Sa: “Jag ska åka på en konferens”. »Jag är på en konferens.«
example.after: „Jag ska åka på en konferens” Sa: ”Jag ska åka på en konferens”. ”Jag är på en konferens.”

rule.name: En-dash without spaces instead of a hyphen between cardinal numbers (range)
rule.description: En-dash without spaces instead of a hyphen with or without spaces between cardinal numbers (ie. 1–2)

rule.name: En-dash without spaces instead of a hyphen between ordinal numbers where ordinal marker is a suffix
rule.description: Ranges of ordinal numbers are written with an en-dash, without spaces

example.before: 1st - 3rd (English) 1ª-3ª (Portuguese) 1.ª—3.ª o 1.º-3.º (Spanish) 1:a-3:e (Swedish) 1re-100e (French; suffix should be in superscript form)
example.after: 1st–3rd (English) 1ª–3ª (Portuguese) 1.ª–3.ª o 1.º–3.º (Spanish) 1:a–3:e (Swedish) 1re-100e (French; suffix should be in superscript form)

rule.name: Hyphens instead of dashes between four number groups (ISBN)
rule.description: Hyphens instead of dashes between four number groups (ISBN) incl. control number X

rule.name: Change hyphen to a dash at the beginning of a paragraph
rule.description: Change hyphen to a dash followed by a fixed width space at the beginning of a paragraph (- hello > – hello) to create dialogs or lists

example.before: - word - 2,000 - “word” -hello -200 (no change)
example.after: – word – 2,000 – “word” - hello -200 (no change)

rule.name: Endash without spaces instead of a hyphen between a span of week days (ie. mo–fr)
rule.description: The days of the week are written with an en-dash, without spaces on either side

example.before: pondělí - pátek (Czech) Mo – Fr (English) poniedziałek-piątek (Polish) пн-пт (Bulgarian) lun. – ven. (French) Fr-So (German) Man - Søn (Danish) H-Sze (Hungarian) joi – sâm. (Romanian) E - R (Estonian) Pr - Sv (Latvian) Pr—Pn (Lithuanian) lun. - mar. (Spanish)
example.after: pondělí–pátek (Czech) Mo–Fr (English) poniedziałek–piątek (Polish) пн–пт (Bulgarian) lun.–ven. (French) Fr–So (German) Man–Søn (Danish) H–Sze (Hungarian) joi–sâm. (Romanian) E–R (Estonian) Pr–Sv (Latvian) Pr–Pn (Lithuanian) lun.–mar. (Spanish)

rule.name: En-dash without spaces instead of a hyphen between a span of months (January–March)
rule.description: A range of months is written with an en-dash and no spaces on either side

example.before: November — December (English, Hungarian, Swedish, Danish, Dutch) leden - květen (Czech) January – March (English) marts-juni (Danish) lokakuu - marraskuu (Finnish) oktoober – november (Estonian) enero — marzo de 2002 (Spanish) octombrie - noiembrie (Romanian) oktobris - novembris (Latvian) spalis -lapkritis (Lithuanian) outubro- novembro (Portuguese) Styczeń-grudzień (Polish) Dúnta Eanáir-Feabhra (Irish)
example.after: November–December (English, Hungarian, Swedish, Danish, Dutch) leden–květen (Czech) January–March (English) marts–juni (Danish) lokakuu–marraskuu (Finnish) oktoober–november (Estonian) enero–marzo de 2002 (Spanish) octombrie–noiembrie (Romanian) oktobris–novembris (Latvian) spalis–lapkritis (Lithuanian) outubro–novembro (Portuguese) Styczeń–grudzień (Polish) Dúnta Eanáir–Feabhra (Irish)

rule.name: Hyphens instead of dashes between two number groups (ISSN)
